summary: Extracts and plays audio from a Movie File In TOP, with audio-track selection, sync offset, timeout, play, and volume controls.
key_concepts: Audio Movie CHOP plays the audio from a Movie File In TOP source.
Movie File In TOP selects the video/movie source whose audio stream is read.
Play disables or enables audio output without changing the source TOP.
Pre-Read Length and Open Timeout control how much audio is cached and how long opening can wait before outputting silence.
Audio Sync Offset compensates for playback latency, such as buffering introduced by Audio Device Out CHOP.

key_params.name: play
key_params.note: Play or stop movie audio output

key_params.name: prereadlength
key_params.note: Read-ahead cache length for movie audio

key_params.name: syncoffset
key_params.note: Audio sync offset relative to movie playback

common_gotchas: The Movie File In TOP must expose audio; image-only sources will not produce useful channels.
Audio track indexes are source dependent.
Sync offset is essential when video/audio latency or buffering differs.
Tie playback state to the source movie player when deterministic AV sync matters.
